address: 63 Halkett Place, Saint Helier, JE2 4WG, United Kingdom
bio: Owner and self-taught chef, Stephen, takes inspiration from his travels and discoveries across Asia when compiling the immensely appealing menu at this cute neighbourhood spot, which resembles something between a little bistro and an izakaya. There are lots of local ingredients, the bao buns are delicious, and be sure to end with the Japanese French toast....
